back: Detected true events divided by all true events. An event is detected if any alarm overlaps it.
One flagged point marks the whole event as found. It inflates F1; even random scores can look good.

front: Why not use accuracy for anomalies?
back: Anomalies are about 1% of points. Always saying 'normal' gives 99% accuracy and finds nothing.
Early detection inside an anomaly window, and it penalises false alarms. It has three application profiles.

front: What baselines should you compare with?
back: A random score, a rolling z-score, and 'same time last week' residuals.
